recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血可見血小板明顯增多且含大型血小板，紅血球大小不一；右圖骨髓鐵染色可見紅血球母細胞核周圍環狀排列的藍色鐵顆粒（ring sideroblasts），合併血小板增多應考慮 MDS/MPN-RS-T。
features: Peripheral blood with markedly increased platelets, including large and giant granular platelets
Red cell anisocytosis with occasional larger and paler cells suggesting a dimorphic population
Iron stain of marrow aspirate showing erythroblasts with blue siderotic granules encircling the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Large megakaryocyte with abundant cytoplasm in the iron-stained field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked thrombocytosis with numerous large and occasional giant platelets, and mild red cell anisocytosis with a subpopulation of larger, paler cells. Bone marrow aspirate stained for iron shows erythroid precursors with coarse siderotic granules arranged around the nucleus, qualifying as ring sideroblasts, adjacent to a large megakaryocyte. The percentage of ring sideroblasts and megakaryocyte morphology require quantitation on the full smear and biopsy. In a patient with persistent thrombocytosis, findings are suggestive of myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis (MDS/MPN-RS-T), typically SF3B1 mutated with frequent JAK2 V617F.

ddx.vs: ET lacks ring sideroblasts (<15%) and dyserythropoiesis and does not carry SF3B1 mutation as a defining lesion.
MDS-RS has a platelet count below 450 x 10^9/L and lacks the large atypical megakaryocytes of MDS/MPN-RS-T.

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired secondary sideroblastic anemia
ddx.vs: Alcohol, copper deficiency, drugs (isoniazid, linezolid), and ALAS2 defects cause ring sideroblasts without clonal thrombocytosis or SF3B1/JAK2 mutations.
